video_info.title: India Tour of New Zealand 2026
video_info.shortDescription: India declared at 720/9 to lock in a 352-run first-innings lead, then struck twice before stumps to leave New Zealand at 119/2, still 233 runs behind. Day 5 sets up a gripping contest as Devon Conway and Rachin Ravindra look to dig in and save the Test, while India pushes for early breakthroughs to seal a memorable win.
